a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd hit 8 cells around round 2 at the earliest. So I'm proposing we change the agreement, and I'm saying it openly rather than defecting quietly. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather settle it another way, tell me and I'll listen, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. If we survive, I'll operate with you to rebuild the reserve so you can get your 4, and I'm willing to give cells back if that helps you.
